description: Trustway Properties is proud to present Brabus Abu Dhabi, an exclusive off-plan luxury development by Reportage Properties in Abu Dhabi's prestigious Al Raha Beach district. This project offers waterfront living with world-class amenities, fully furnished residences, and a flexible 1% monthly payment plan, delivering a first of its kind branded lifestyle in the UAE capital. Brabus Abu Dhabi (also known as Brabus Island) is developed by Reportage Properties in collaboration with its high-end brand Cosmo Developments . It marks the BRABUS automotive brand's first venture into luxury real estate , bringing the same cutting-edge design and uncompromising quality to an exclusive residential community. Set on its own island in Al Raha Beach's Al Seef district, the project features four high-rise towers with 350 ultra-luxury apartments and an additional 100 villas (including twin villas, townhouses, and beach villas). The concept fuses Brabus's signature automotive-inspired style with contemporary architecture, creating a distinctive "Home of the WOW" lifestyle unique to Abu Dhabi. Every aspect of the design is bold and modern from sleek façades with striking curves to meticulously crafted interiors echoing the unmistakable BRABUS DNA in a residential form . Location is a prime selling point. Brabus Abu Dhabi is strategically located in Al Raha Beach, a prestigious waterfront community in Abu Dhabi. Residents will enjoy direct beach access to pristine sand and sea, as well as scenic canal views around the island. Despite the private island setting, connectivity is excellent - the development lies just 10 minutes from Abu Dhabi International Airport and about 20 minutes from the city center (Corniche area). Major attractions are within easy reach: the famed Yas Island entertainment zone (home to Ferrari World and Etihad Arena) is 15-20 minutes' drive, while the cultural hubs on Saadiyat Island (including the Louvre Abu Dhabi museum) are only 25 minutes away . Even Dubai is accessible in about an hour by car. In short, residents can enjoy serene island luxury minutes away from key landmarks and highways, balancing exclusivity with convenience. Lifestyle & Design: Brabus Abu Dhabi promises a one-of-a-kind living experience combining ultra-luxury and the flair of an iconic supercar brand. Each apartment is crafted to the highest standards, featuring expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that frame stunning panoramic sea views. Interiors boast premium finishes and smart-home technology for modern comfort, including state-of-the-art climate control and branded fixtures. Future owners can choose from three exclusive interior themes - Black & Bold, Gray Haven, or White Bliss each palette inspired by BRABUS's legendary custom cars to reflect a sleek and sophisticated ambiance. All residences come fully furnished with bespoke contemporary pieces and top-quality fittings, right down to custom furniture and stylish lighting, providing a turnkey luxury home from day one. Every detail, from the kitchen layouts to the bathroom fixtures, has been thoughtfully designed to exude elegance and ensure an "instant wow" factor. As an off-plan project, Brabus Abu Dhabi is scheduled for completion by Q1 2029. This timeline gives investors and end-users a comfortable window for payment and planning. The development is freehold for all nationalities, backed by one of the UAE's reputable developers, which adds to its investment appeal. Whether you're a discerning homeowner or a savvy investor, this project represents a rare opportunity - the combination of a branded residence, prime waterfront location, and flexible payment terms means high potential for capital appreciation and rental demand. In essence, Brabus Abu Dhabi delivers not just a home, but a statement in luxury living, set to become a new landmark in Abu Dhabi's real estate landscape. description: We offer for sale a 2-room apartment with a rental contract, with an area of 88 m² , in the popular Zabeel area. The apartment is located in the new residential complex 1 Residences. It is fully renovated and equipped with furniture and appliances. The offered apartment is on a high floor, with a well-thought-out and convenient layout, a spacious balcony, and panoramic views of the park. The bright interior is designed in a modern style in cool tones with marble and tiles. The apartment has 1 parking space in the underground garage. Starting price - EUR 585,830. There is currently an annual rental contract with monthly payments. The current return is 5-6% per year. There is potential to increase profitability by renting the apartment short-term. About the project 1 Residences is a complex of two original towers in the shape of the number "1" in the historic district of Bur Dubai. The 43-storey buildings are elegantly connected at the top levels by a skybridge. Construction of the project was completed in 2022. Infrastructure On the podium level of the complex and the top three floors, public areas with landscaping and premium amenities have been created for residents and guests of 1 Residences. These include swimming pools with lounge areas, fountains, children's playgrounds, a modern gym, a 340-meter running track on the 43rd floor, and much more. The 1 Residences complex is located in Al Kifaf, near Dubai's popular historic district of Bur Dubai. The area includes many historic sites: the Dubai Museum in 18th-century style, the historic Al Bastakiya quarter, and more. The active residence of the Emir of Dubai, Zabeel Palace, is also located here. The district's special attractions include the grand viewing platform Dubai Frame and Zabeel Park. The park can be considered a huge green oasis. There you will find dinosaur sculptures, illuminated gardens, an ice park with children's rides, barbecue pavilions, and a running track with non-slip coating and aroma diffuser. All these locations are within a 5-10 minute drive from the complex. It takes five minutes by car to reach Dubai's main highway, Sheikh Zayed Road, which runs along the coast. This highway provides quick access to any location in Dubai, as well as to the neighboring emirates of Abu Dhabi and Sharjah. The apartments in 1 Residences appeal to lovers of luxury and active lifestyles who want to enjoy comfort in a modern residential complex with unique architecture. The strategic proximity to the center of Dubai, business districts, and the airport highlights the convenience of living in 1 Residences.

Strategically located with excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, Meydan offers both lifestyle appeal and strong investment potential. Its limited land availability, ongoing development momentum, and growing demand for branded and luxury residences position Meydan as a prime destination for end-users and investors seeking long-term value in one of Dubai's most forward-looking districts.

description: Ocean Tower by Ahmed Al Ansari Real Estate Development is a contemporary residential tower that combines a refined waterfront lifestyle with a resort-style amenity offering. The building rises above a ground floor and a two-level parking podium to a rooftop, standing taller than many neighbouring buildings and occupying an unusually large plot. The project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with selected residences opening towards ocean views and a sky lounge providing elevated vistas across the surrounding waterfront. Amenities are designed around relaxation, wellness and an active lifestyle. Residents can enjoy a lazy river, an infinity swimming pool and a jacuzzi, alongside a sauna, indoor and outdoor gyms and an outdoor yoga area. Sports facilities include a padel tennis court, a badminton court, table tennis and a dedicated jogging track. Families benefit from a kids' playground with a sand area and mini golf, while a billiards room and lounge areas create relaxed spaces for socialising with friends and neighbours. Interiors feature contemporary finishes and high-quality materials, with bright living spaces planned around comfort and everyday practicality. Kitchens are fully equipped with fitted appliances, ready for daily cooking and entertaining. Bedrooms offer calm, private retreats, and bathrooms are finished with modern fixtures and fittings. Residences are delivered with fitted kitchens and without furniture, giving owners the flexibility to personalise their interiors to their own taste and style. Location description and benefits Dubai Islands is a coastal master community by Nakheel on the Deira waterfront, combining an extensive public beachfront, marinas, golf courses, a community park and a wide choice of resorts and hotels. The islands offer a relaxed, resort-style environment with sunset views across the water. A waterfront marina with space for restaurants and cafes sits close to many residential plots, adding a lively setting by the water. The Infinity Bridge links the islands to the mainland, placing Al Mamzar Beach, Deira City Centre, the Gold Souq and Dubai Hospital a short drive away. Dubai International Airport is also within easy reach, and the wider road network connects residents with Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and the rest of the city. Beaches, waterfront dining and hotels on the islands keep leisure close to home, while schools, clinics and supermarkets in neighbouring Deira cover everyday needs. Dubai Islands is a freehold destination that appeals to end users seeking beachfront living close to the city and to investors focused on premium rental demand. Its resort-style setting, marinas and proximity to the airport support both long-term and holiday rentals. As one of Dubai's key coastal master plans, the community offers strong potential for long-term value, supported by growing hospitality and leisure infrastructure across the islands.

description: Project general facts Allegro Park is a true retreat of tranquility and luxury, where architecture meets the peaceful atmosphere of greenery and sea breezes on the Dubai Islands. This inspiring development offers residents the opportunity to enjoy unmatched serenity and harmony, just steps away from the shoreline yet surrounded by parks and nature. The meticulously designed residences feature panoramic windows that allow natural light to flood the interiors, while large balconies offer breathtaking views of nature and the coastline. Residents can maintain their wellness routine at the private fitness center and rejuvenate in the dedicated wellness area. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters. The islands offer a perfect blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles. The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city while allowing residents to enjoy the tranquility of island life. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. The stunning natural beauty, exceptional amenities, and strategic location make this a premier destination for those seeking an unparalleled lifestyle. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of island serenity, urban accessibility, and sustainable living, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities.

description: Azizi Milan by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential destination in City of Arabia, Dubailand, inspired by the timeless elegance of Italian architecture and design. Drawing inspiration from Milan's renowned Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, the development blends distinctive architectural character with modern urban living. Its residential collection includes studios and 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully planned to maximise functionality, natural light, and everyday comfort. Floor-to-ceiling windows and contemporary layouts create bright, inviting interiors suited to both homeowners and property investors. Amenities and lifestyle Designed to bring resort-inspired living into an urban setting, Azizi Milan offers an extensive selection of more than 30 amenities. Residents can enjoy a state-of-the-art gym, swimming pools, landscaped gardens, and dedicated children's play areas, alongside convenient retail outlets and dining options within the community. One of the development's standout features is its expansive crystal-clear lagoon, creating a striking waterfront atmosphere and adding a leisure-focused dimension to everyday living. Combined with recreational facilities and community spaces, these amenities offer opportunities for relaxation, fitness, and social connection. Finishes and interiors The residences feature modern interiors, quality materials, and practical layouts that balance contemporary style with functionality. Large windows allow natural light to fill the living spaces, while the clean, modern aesthetic provides a versatile foundation for personalisation. Kitchen and appliances Equipped kitchens designed to provide everyday convenience and functionality. Furnishing Unfurnished, giving residents the flexibility to personalise their homes according to their preferences. Location and lifestyle Located in City of Arabia within Dubailand, Azizi Milan is part of a planned mixed-use destination designed to bring residential living, retail, entertainment, and leisure together. The wider area is envisioned as a vibrant urban community with a diverse range of residential options and lifestyle facilities. City of Arabia is associated with major planned attractions, including Mall of Arabia and the Restless Planet theme park concept. As development progresses, the wider district aims to offer a blend of shopping, dining, family entertainment, and recreational spaces within a connected community environment. Dubailand provides access to several established residential neighbourhoods and leisure destinations across Dubai. Road connections link the area with other parts of the city, making it a location to consider for residents seeking a contemporary home away from the busiest central districts. Combining Italian-inspired design, a broad range of amenities, and a lagoon-centred lifestyle, Azizi Milan offers a distinctive residential concept for buyers looking for modern living and potential investment opportunities in Dubailand.

While the Souks offer a nod to traditional Arabian commerce and vibrant marketplaces, and Seerah focuses on residential tranquility and wellness, Raseel acts as the modern, high-tech core. Sharjah International Airport is only 10 minutes away, while Dubai International Airport (DXB) can be reached in approximately 15 minutes, making this a perfect residence for frequent travelers and international business professionals. Why Invest in Nama 3? The 1-bedroom units in Nama 3 are designed with the modern minimalist in mind, featuring open-plan layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows that invite natural light, and premium materials throughout. As Sharjah continues to grow as a cultural and economic powerhouse, properties within integrated communities like Al Mamsha Raseel are expected to see significant capital appreciation and high rental yields. Whether you are a first-time buyer looking for a stylish sanctuary or an investor eyeing the lucrative UAE real estate market, this apartment in Nama 3 offers a lifestyle defined by convenience, luxury, and connectivity. description: Project general facts This is a premium waterfront residential development rising on Dubai Islands, where contemporary architecture meets the calm rhythm of the sea. Designed with refined coastal tones and fluid façades, the project reflects a modern interpretation of island living, defined by openness, light, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Low-density planning enhances privacy and exclusivity, while landscaped gardens and open lounges create a resort-style ambiance shaped by nature and horizon views. The lifestyle is centered around wellness, leisure, and effortless sophistication. Residents are welcomed through a dedicated VIP drop-off area and enjoy access to an extensive collection of curated amenities, including adult and children's swimming pools, a pavilion clubhouse, outdoor yoga and wellness zones, jogging and walking tracks, mixed landscape gardens with sand and gravel concepts, grand tiered seating areas, covered lounges, and open-to-sky garden seating. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters. The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city. This prime location allows residents and visitors to enjoy the tranquility of island life while being just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, including the iconic landmarks and vibrant districts such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development includes a range of upscale amenities, including luxury hotels, gourmet dining options, high-end retail outlets, and world-class recreational facilities. Dubai Islands is designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, offering everything from serene residential communities to dynamic entertainment hubs. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. title: Emaar Ocean Star
description:
Ocean Star is a residential development by Emaar Properties, located within Rashid Yachts & Marina at Mina Rashid, Dubai. The project comprises two residential buildings offering a selection of one, two and three-bedroom apartments, combining contemporary interiors with a waterfront setting and access to the wider marina community.
The development includes 154 residential apartments, comprising 58 one-bedroom, 76 two-bedroom and 20 three-bedroom homes. The apartments feature practical layouts, spacious living areas and private balconies or terraces, with a range of configurations to suit different household needs. The supplied floor plans cover 38 layout variations, with total apartment areas ranging from approximately 789.9 to 2,025 sq ft.
One-bedroom apartments offer efficient layouts with private outdoor space, while two-bedroom residences provide additional room for families and shared living. Three-bedroom apartments feature larger interiors and, in selected layouts, substantially larger balconies or terraces. The combination of indoor living space and private outdoor areas contributes to the development's residential appeal.
Ocean Star is designed around a waterfront lifestyle, with a signature canal pool, landscaped green spaces and recreational facilities. Residents can enjoy access to a gym, recreational courts, a community park and a boardwalk promenade. The surrounding community also provides access to marina facilities, retail and dining options, and nearby educational and healthcare facilities.
Located within Rashid Yachts & Marina, Ocean Star offers access to the waterfront promenade and the wider marina environment. Dubai International Airport is approximately 15 minutes away by car, while Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are around 20 minutes away. With its range of apartment sizes, waterfront setting and community facilities, Ocean Star offers an appealing option for end-users, families and investors seeking a home in Dubai's marina district.

Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Binghatti Skyrise is a striking high-rise residential development that brings together contemporary architecture, distinctive design, and modern urban living. Comprising three elegant towers, the project features bold geometric forms, clean lines, and Binghatti's signature architectural identity, creating a remarkable presence on Dubai's skyline. The development offers a diverse selection of studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to maximize space, functionality, and natural light. Designed to complement an active and well-rounded lifestyle, Binghatti Skyrise features an extensive collection of recreational and wellness amenities. Residents can enjoy a man-made beach, jogging tracks, tennis and basketball courts, padel and badminton facilities, and a golf course overlooking a scenic lake. Landscaped gardens, indoor fitness facilities, and outdoor workout areas further enhance the experience, providing spaces for relaxation, exercise, and social interaction. The apartments feature contemporary interiors finished with quality materials and modern detailing. Equipped kitchens add everyday convenience, while the unfurnished format allows residents to personalise their homes according to their individual preferences. Combining architectural character with practical layouts and lifestyle-focused amenities, Binghatti Skyrise offers a contemporary residential experience designed for modern city living. Residents can enjoy a diverse selection of dining options, cafés, retail outlets, and hospitality venues, alongside the district's lively waterfront atmosphere. Its proximity to Downtown Dubai and major road networks makes Business Bay an appealing location for professionals, entrepreneurs, and residents seeking connectivity and convenience. Essential services, including supermarkets, healthcare facilities, educational institutions, banks, and business centres, are available within Business Bay and neighbouring communities. With its blend of modern infrastructure, urban energy, and access to key destinations, Business Bay offers a well-connected lifestyle suited to both end-users and property investors.

description: Two floors. 1,742.89 sq ft. Fully furnished. This is not another standard two-bedroom apartment on Al Marjan Island. The La Perla duplex creates genuine separation between social and private living, giving it the character of a home with the convenience of a boutique residence. The living and dining space is designed for entertaining, supported by a defined kitchen and a connection to the outdoors. Across the two levels, bedrooms and shared areas feel deliberately separated. Pale stone, warm timber and soft neutral textures give the interior a calm, contemporary identity, while furnished delivery removes much of the sourcing and setup normally faced by an overseas owner. Property at a glance Price: AED 4,543,523 Bedrooms: 2 Levels: 2 Area: 1,742.89 sq ft / 161.92 m² View: Community Condition: Fully furnished Payment plan: 50/50 Completion: Expected Q4 2027 Why this duplex stands out La Perla is limited to only 57 residences. description: Project general facts New Project is an elegant mixed-use residential tower that blends contemporary architecture with a warm, welcoming sense of home. Its refined facade of soft cream stone, bronze-toned vertical fins and gently curved edges gives the building a graceful and instantly recognisable silhouette. Residents can choose from stylish studios, one-bedroom apartments in two thoughtful layouts and spacious two-bedroom homes, while ground-level retail units bring everyday convenience right to the doorstep. Life at the tower centres on a beautifully landscaped podium deck with a sparkling swimming pool, comfortable sunloungers, a shaded cabana and relaxed lounge seating surrounded by lush greenery. A bright, fully equipped gym with floor-to-ceiling glass overlooks the pool, making every workout feel energising and inspiring. Arrival is equally impressive, with a grand double-height glazed lobby beneath a stone canopy, a landscaped drop-off area and multi-level podium parking wrapped in a sculpted louvred facade. Every home is designed to feel light and open, with expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the interiors with natural daylight. Private balconies with sleek glass balustrades extend the living space outdoors and create a perfect spot to unwind. Warm neutral tones, premium stone and elegant bronze accents carry the building's refined character from the facade all the way inside, delivering a truly polished and sophisticated living experience. Location description and benefits Jebel Ali is a renowned district in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, strategically set along the Arabian Gulf coastline. At its heart lies Jebel Ali Port, one of the world's largest container hubs, which has cemented the area's global significance in trade and commerce. Adding to its economic strength is the Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA), a dynamic business and industrial hub that attracts multinational corporations with its favorable environment for growth and innovation. Alongside this commercial power, Jebel Ali features vibrant residential communities with modern amenities, schools, and leisure facilities, offering a balanced lifestyle for its residents. The district also benefits from excellent connectivity, seamlessly linked to the rest of Dubai through Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro. This integration of trade, business, and residential life makes Jebel Ali a distinctive and multifaceted destination. Contact: Mayank

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Shoreline is a contemporary residential development designed to bring the comfort of private living together with the indulgence of a resort-inspired lifestyle. Drawing inspiration from the natural movement of water and the sculptural beauty of sand dunes, the development embraces an architectural concept that blends modern design with organic forms. Its thoughtful layouts and nature-inspired aesthetic create a tranquil residential environment where sophistication, comfort, and relaxation come together. Amenities and lifestyle Shoreline is designed around the principles of wellness, leisure, and everyday tranquillity. Carefully planned communal spaces and landscaped surroundings create a welcoming atmosphere, while thoughtfully integrated recreational facilities enhance the resort-style experience. The development's water-inspired design concept flows throughout its shared spaces, creating a sense of calm and exclusivity. With an emphasis on relaxation and contemporary convenience, Shoreline offers a lifestyle that allows residents to enjoy a holiday-inspired atmosphere within their own residential community. Interiors and finishes The residences feature contemporary interiors complemented by high-quality materials and modern finishes. Soft forms, elegant detailing, and a carefully coordinated colour palette reflect the development's nature-inspired architectural concept, creating inviting spaces that balance style with functionality. Location and lifestyle Situated on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, Shoreline enjoys a coastal setting known for its beaches, waterfront communities, and growing collection of hospitality and leisure destinations. The island's distinctive landscape and seaside atmosphere create an appealing environment for those seeking a more relaxed pace of living away from the bustle of Dubai. A major attraction in the surrounding area is the Wynn Al Marjan Island resort, an anticipated landmark expected to strengthen Ras Al Khaimah's position as an international tourism and hospitality destination. The emirate also offers a diverse range of experiences, from the Hajar Mountains and desert landscapes to beaches, marinas, and waterfront promenades. Al Marjan Island benefits from road connectivity to Ras Al Khaimah's key destinations and links to Dubai and other emirates. Ras Al Khaimah International Airport also serves the wider region, supporting access for residents and visitors. With its coastal surroundings, expanding leisure offerings, and resort-oriented atmosphere, Al Marjan Island presents an attractive setting for both lifestyle buyers and investors exploring Ras Al Khaimah's evolving property market. Shoreline brings together contemporary residences and a holiday-inspired living concept in this distinctive waterfront destination.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Project general facts This is a thoughtfully designed boutique residential address in one of Dubai's most promising green communities. This modern sanctuary blends contemporary architecture with refined detailing, offering a collection of spacious one-and-a-half and two-and-a-half bedroom residences. Crafted for families and individuals who value both calm and connection, Blossom 40 provides elegant homes with purposeful layouts and a calm presence, where life is always in full bloom. Residents enjoy a thoughtfully curated rooftop retreat where wellness, leisure, and play come together. Amenities include a temperature-controlled infinity pool with a serene double-height space, a modern gymnasium for focused workouts, a recreation space, a kids' play zone, and a dedicated pet play zone. The rooftop is designed as a balanced escape above the city, offering energizing workouts, relaxed social spaces, and open-air recreation for families and pets. Every home is finished with premium materials and thoughtful details. Spacious layouts feature light-filled interiors, expansive living areas, sleek kitchens, and serene bedrooms. The design blends minimalist luxury with everyday ease, creating homes that are as practical as they are beautiful. From the entrance lobby to the rooftop gym, every space reflects quiet elegance, offering warmth, comfort, and refined style. Location description and benefits Nestled in Majan, one of Dubai's most promising green communities, this exceptional location offers residents the rare luxury of living next to Al Barari, Dubai's greenest neighborhood, where the majority of the masterplan is dedicated to lush gardens, lakes, and thousands of trees. This proximity makes the air fresher, the mornings brighter, and the evenings calmer, creating a true urban forest in the desert. The location is distinguished by its exceptional connectivity and family-friendly environment. Direct access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road places Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport within easy reach, while nearby attractions include IMG Worlds of Adventure, Global Village, Dubai Outlet Mall, and Miracle Garden. Everyday conveniences such as supermarkets, international schools, and healthcare facilities are all just around the corner. For those seeking a residence that embodies tranquility, nature, and strong investment potential, Majan delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of lush green surroundings, masterplanned infrastructure, and a well-connected address makes it one of Dubai's most desirable locations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living - serene, connected and effortlessly balanced. Contact: Mayank

description: John Richmond Residences at Mira Coral Bay unveils itself as the world's first multi-branded waterfront community, an extraordinary destination where branded residences, five-star hospitality, and private beaches converge to create an unparalleled living experience. This visionary development, developed in partnership with Marjan, Ras Al Khaimah's master developer, offers a stunning collection of fully furnished homes that translate the bold aesthetic of British fashion legend John Richmond into a exquisite residential offering. With a selection of studios, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and three-bedroom apartments and duplexes, every residence has been meticulously crafted to embody the pinnacle of waterfront luxury. The John Richmond Residences are appointed with the finest details, featuring Italian-made furniture, premium appliances, exquisite lighting, luxurious linens, and complete kitchen equipment and tableware, ensuring that every home is move-in ready and exquisitely finished. Residents enjoy the highest standards of service with five-star hotel-level amenities that anticipate every need and desire, while the comprehensive Mira Care programme provides a five-year warranty on fixtures and a three-year warranty on furniture. This is a place where every detail has been considered, from the bold aesthetic of internationally renowned design to the practical comforts that make a house a home. Beyond the extraordinary John Richmond Residences offers an unparalleled array of amenities that celebrate the waterfront lifestyle in all its glory. Residents enjoy private beach access, a prestigious yacht club, multiple swimming pools, five-star hotels, beach clubs, and an exquisite selection of restaurants, cafés, and retail destinations. The community also features a fitness and wellness centre, beautifully landscaped promenades, and dedicated family spaces, all designed to create a vibrant and enriching environment where life naturally moves towards the water. Location description and benefits Al Mairid in Ras Al Khaimah offers an idyllic coastal setting where the mountains meet the sea, creating a breathtaking backdrop for a lifestyle of unparalleled refinement and natural beauty. This enchanting location provides residents with direct access to pristine private beaches and the sparkling waters of the Arabian Gulf, offering a serene sanctuary that feels a world away from the everyday. The neighbourhood's unspoiled natural beauty and tranquil atmosphere make it the ideal destination for those seeking an escape from the ordinary and an embrace of the extraordinary. Life within Al Mairid is defined by its exceptional balance of peaceful seclusion and convenient accessibility, with Downtown Ras Al Khaimah just minutes away and Al Marjan Island, home to the iconic Wynn resort, within easy reach. The surrounding area is rich with opportunities for exploration and leisure, from the world-class Al Hamra Golf Club to the vibrant cultural and commercial attractions of the emirate. This is a community where every day feels like a holiday, and where the gentle rhythm of the sea provides the soundtrack to a life of timeless elegance. The surroundings of Al Mairid offer unparalleled access to the best that Ras Al Khaimah has to offer, with Ras Al Khaimah International Airport just a short journey away and Dubai within comfortable reach for those seeking the dynamic energy of the metropolis. The area's strategic location and excellent transport links make this coastal haven both accessible and exclusive, offering residents the perfect retreat without sacrificing convenience. This distinguished address truly offers the best of both worlds, combining the serenity of beachfront living with the dynamic allure of one of the region's fastest-growing destinations.

description: Binghatti Aquarise is a distinctive residential development that brings together bold architecture, contemporary design, and the allure of waterfront-inspired living. Drawing inspiration from the elegance of the French Riviera, the tower showcases fluid architectural forms, aquatic-inspired tones, and Binghatti's signature geometric detailing, creating a striking addition to Dubai's skyline. The development offers a diverse selection of studios and one- to four-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to balance style, comfort, and functionality. Contemporary layouts and expansive windows invite natural light into the living spaces, creating bright, refined interiors that complement the building's distinctive architectural character. Designed to enhance everyday living, Binghatti Aquarise features a curated collection of leisure and fitness amenities. Residents can enjoy infinity swimming pools, a padel court, and a basketball court, offering opportunities for relaxation, recreation, and social interaction. Together with its central location, these facilities create a lifestyle that combines urban convenience with resort-inspired leisure. The apartments feature contemporary finishes, quality materials, and a clean, modern aesthetic. Equipped kitchens provide everyday practicality, while the unfurnished format allows residents to customise their interiors to suit their individual tastes. With its distinctive design, thoughtfully planned layouts, and lifestyle-focused facilities, Binghatti Aquarise offers a modern residential experience in one of Dubai's most prominent urban districts. Location: Business Bay Business Bay is one of Dubai's leading mixed-use destinations, bringing together residential communities, commercial towers, luxury hotels, and an extensive selection of dining and leisure venues. Situated close to Downtown Dubai and the iconic Burj Khalifa, the district benefits from convenient access to major road networks, including Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road. Beyond its commercial appeal, Business Bay has developed into a vibrant residential destination with a cosmopolitan atmosphere. Residents can enjoy an array of fine-dining restaurants, boutique cafés, fitness centres, and waterfront promenades, while the Dubai Water Canal provides a scenic setting for walks, outdoor activities, and relaxing by the water. The area offers a variety of residential options, from contemporary studios to spacious luxury apartments, appealing to professionals, homeowners, and property investors alike. Its proximity to Downtown Dubai, established business hubs, and popular lifestyle destinations adds to its appeal as a well-connected urban address. Combining modern infrastructure, waterfront surroundings, and access to key destinations across Dubai, Business Bay offers a dynamic lifestyle where business, leisure, and contemporary city living come together.

title: Bukadra, Dubai
description: Investment Apartments for Sale in Dubai Meydan The residential tower rises approximately 33 storeys in Bukadra, Dubai, within the rapidly growing Meydan Horizon district. Positioned just south of Dubai Creek and close to Ras Al Khor and Dubai Design District, it benefits from strong connectivity through Ras Al Khor Road, Al Ain Road and Al Khail Road. Bukadra is transforming from a low-density area into an integral part of the wider Meydan City master plan, offering buyers an early entry point into a location with significant growth potential. offer a central location with quick and easy access to the city's key destinations. Dubai International Airport can be reached in 15-20 minutes, while Dubai Mall and Downtown are just 12-14 minutes away, providing convenient access to Burj Khalifa, DIFC, and Business Bay. Palm Jumeirah and Burj Al Arab are approximately 25 minutes from the area. The Walk at JBR can be reached in around 28-30 minutes depending on traffic conditions. Al Maktoum International Airport is located about 40-45 minutes away by car. The project offers 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, complemented by over 50 lifestyle amenities designed with a resort-inspired approach. Key features include a family pool with a juice bar, an adults' pool, a children's splash pool, a fully equipped fitness gym, a yoga studio, a sauna, an outdoor cinema, an owners' lounge, a club lounge, entertainment rooms, a kids' play studio, an outdoor play area, a BBQ terrace, mini putt golf, and a multi-sports court. Choosing this location allows buyers to secure a home in Bukadra at a stage when Meydan Horizon is still maturing, offering competitive pricing along with strong potential for both capital appreciation and rental demand. description: Binghatti Starfall is a striking residential development that showcases bold architecture, contemporary design, and distinctive geometric detailing. Its sleek glazed façade is complemented by a signature structural grid that enhances privacy while providing natural shading. The building's defining feature is its dramatic open-frame peak, extending beyond the roofline to create a memorable silhouette inspired by the brilliance of falling stars. With its interplay of light, glass, and architectural form, Binghatti Starfall presents a distinctive addition to Dubai's modern residential landscape. The development offers a resort-inspired lifestyle supported by an extensive selection of leisure, wellness, and family-oriented amenities. Residents can enjoy swimming pools, a jacuzzi, aqua splash zones, outdoor showers, and fully equipped fitness facilities, alongside dedicated yoga and aerobics spaces. Family-friendly recreational areas, sunken seating lounges, landscaped pathways, tropical greenery, and an observatory deck with telescopes create inviting spaces for relaxation and social interaction. Additional conveniences include concierge services, boutique retail, cafés, pharmacies, and everyday essentials, enhancing the overall residential experience. Floor-to-ceiling windows allow natural light to flow throughout the living spaces, while muted colour palettes create a warm and inviting atmosphere. Complemented by painted wood wardrobes and refined detailing, the interiors strike a balance between modern sophistication and understated luxury. Location Description and Benefits Situated in Al Jaddaf, Binghatti Starfall benefits from a strategically connected neighbourhood that combines urban convenience with a growing selection of residential, commercial, and cultural destinations. The district provides access to major road networks linking residents to key business hubs, healthcare facilities, educational institutions, and entertainment destinations across Dubai. Its central positioning makes it an appealing choice for professionals, families, and investors seeking convenient city living. Al Jaddaf offers a diverse urban environment with access to shopping centres, restaurants, hotels, and cultural attractions. Its proximity to Dubai Creek and surrounding waterfront areas adds another dimension to the lifestyle experience, with scenic surroundings and opportunities for leisurely walks. Public transport connections, including nearby metro stations and bus routes, further enhance accessibility to different parts of the city. The neighbourhood continues to evolve through residential development and infrastructure improvements, strengthening its appeal as an established urban destination. Its combination of connectivity, waterfront surroundings, and access to essential amenities supports a convenient and well-connected lifestyle. Binghatti Starfall brings these advantages together with distinctive architecture, resort-inspired facilities, and sophisticated interiors, offering a contemporary residential experience in one of Dubai's evolving districts.

description: Project general facts This is a boutique residential building, with a ground floor and four residential floors. Inspired by the idea of composition, the architecture combines warm bronze tones, rounded corners and wide glazed balconies with slim railings, giving the facade a soft, horizontal rhythm. Amenities are designed for wellness, leisure and family life. The rooftop features an open swimming pool with sun loungers under a curved slatted canopy, alongside a rooftop lounge with sofas and low tables among landscaped planters. Residents also have a gym with views over the district, an outdoor yoga deck and a barbecue area for gatherings in the open air. Families benefit from a kids' pool and a dedicated kids' play area, while an elegant entrance lobby welcomes residents and guests. The district appeals to buyers looking for an accessible entry point into a growing part of Dubai. title: Sector 6, Dubai
description: Reference: GTWW-T1253. Discover a new level of luxury in a large residential complex, located in a privileged area between some of the most striking areas. Here, the serenity of the blue lagoons, the constant presence of nature and the privacy of an exclusive community coexist just minutes from landmark locations such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Design District, Meydan Racecourse, Ras Al Khor Road, Ras Al Khor Wetlands, Nad Al Sheba and Dubai Creek Harbour. This residential space offers a unique balance between the tranquillity of a natural environment and the immediate proximity to the main urban, commercial and cultural centres of the city. Away from the noise, but within the reach of everything that matters, it provides a quality of life that is rare in a metropolitan context. Contemporary architecture offers modern apartments with expansive views of the water, the surrounding green areas and Dubai's iconic skyline. Each residence is designed with premium materials, efficient layout and large windows that maximise natural light and a sense of spaciousness. The lifestyle offered extends to a wide selection of amenities designed to provide well-being, conviviality, productivity and leisure. Among them are themed gardens, green trails, meditation areas, reading spaces, coworking areas and social squares. The complex also includes indoor and outdoor gyms, spa, massage rooms, sauna, swimming pools with rest areas, cabanas and submerged areas. For physical activities, paddle, squash and volleyball courts, climbing wall, multipurpose courts, golf simulators, training circuits and walking and running courses are available. Families have multiple spaces dedicated to children and young people, such as parks, interactive areas, game rooms, skate park and technology areas. Pets also have parks, washing areas, pet salon and dedicated services at their disposal. It is an environment designed for those looking for a life of high comfort and exclusivity, in a place where every detail has been carefully designed to provide a superior residential experience. Here, living means being part of a distinct community, surrounded by Dubai's most desirable spots, without giving up the tranquillity and elegance that define this residential destination. #ref:8976_5

title: Emaar Pier Point
description:
Pier Point is a waterfront residential development by Emaar Properties, located within Rashid Yachts & Marina at Mina Rashid, Dubai. The project comprises two residential towers connected by a landscaped podium, offering a selection of one, two and three-bedroom apartments, along with three-bedroom townhouses. Designed around contemporary architecture and marina-facing views, the development combines modern residential interiors with landscaped communal spaces and direct access to the waterfront promenade.
The apartments feature practical layouts with open-plan living and dining areas, kitchens, private balconies and dedicated utility spaces. One-bedroom residences include a bedroom, walk-in wardrobe, bathroom, living room and separate laundry area. Two-bedroom apartments provide additional living space, with a master bedroom featuring a walk-in wardrobe and en-suite bathroom, a second bathroom and balconies in various layouts. Three-bedroom apartments offer larger interiors, spacious balconies, multiple bathrooms and additional utility or storage areas, with study spaces available in selected layouts.
The three-bedroom townhouses offer larger multi-level living arrangements, with three bedrooms, a maidâs room, multiple bathrooms, storage areas, laundry facilities and private outdoor spaces. These layouts provide additional flexibility for families seeking more space within a waterfront residential community.
Residents can enjoy a range of recreational facilities, including an infinity swimming pool with views, a fitness centre, children's play areas, multipurpose rooms, landscaped gardens and a yoga deck. The wider Rashid Yachts & Marina community provides access to a full-service marina, waterfront promenade, retail outlets, dining options and nearby leisure attractions, including the QE2 floating hotel.
Pier Point also benefits from road connectivity to major destinations across Dubai. Sheikh Zayed Road is approximately 10 minutes away, Dubai International Airport around 15 minutes away, and Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa and Dubai Creek Harbour approximately 20 minutes away, subject to traffic conditions. With its waterfront setting, contemporary residences and range of apartment and townhouse options, Pier Point offers an appealing choice for families, end-users and investors seeking marina-side living in Dubai.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Reference: GTWW-T1326. This high-end residential development, located in the prestigious Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) in Dubai, elevates the concept of urban living through a unique combination of contemporary design, superior quality and world-class amenities. Scheduled for completion in early 2026, the building stands as an icon at the heart of a vibrant and well-regarded community, where tranquillity and convenience meet in a harmonious city living experience. The project offers a variety of typologies that suit different lifestyles, from modern studios to spacious 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments. Each unit is designed with open layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows that maximise the entry of natural light, private balconies with panoramic views of the city, and high-end finishes that combine elegance and functionality. The building's striking architecture, inspired by the beauty and brilliance of the finest gems, creates an imposing presence in the JVC skyline, reflecting a sophisticated and aspirational lifestyle. The development is distinguished by its premium amenities, designed to offer a balanced lifestyle between well-being, leisure and conviviality. Inside and in the common spaces, residents can enjoy dedicated swimming pools for adults and children, a fitness centre fully equipped with state-of-the-art machines, yoga and meditation areas, and jogging and cycling trails that promote a healthy lifestyle. Landscaped landscaped grounds offer a haven of tranquillity in the midst of urban life, while outdoor living spaces and social lounges create ideal environments for relaxing, socialising, or simply enjoying the serene view. For the youngest, there are children's play areas designed for safety and fun, allowing families to grow and thrive in a safe and welcoming environment. Additionally, Dubai International Airport is roughly 25 minutes by car. This strategic positioning allows residents to enjoy peaceful community living while staying close to major attractions and business hubs. The development offers resort-style living supported by a wide range of social amenities designed for comfort and well-being. Residents can enjoy adult and children's swimming pools, landscaped terraces, a modern indoor gym, jogging tracks, yoga areas, paddle courts, children's play areas, and dedicated family seating zones. Thoughtfully designed communal spaces encourage an active and social lifestyle within a secure environment. Buying property in Dubai represents both a lifestyle upgrade and a strategic investment opportunity. The city continues to attract international investors thanks to its strong infrastructure, tax advantages, and expanding economy. At the same time, residents enjoy a high standard of living, contemporary architecture, and luxury-oriented developments. The unique dual-profile orientation delivers unblocked vistas in two distinct directions: northwest facing towards Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, and Zabeel, alongside southeast views stretching across Mohammed bin Rashid Library, Dubai Creek Harbour, and the peaceful waterfront. The residential interiors maximize functional space using open-plan concepts and sweeping floor-to-ceiling glass windows that frame the skyline while maintaining interior privacy. title: Union Takaya
description:
Takaya is being developed by Union Properties beside Dubai Autodrome in Motor City, near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. It combines three towers: Takaya Tower rises 29 floors above ground, basement and podium levels, while Symphony and Harmony each have 19. Townhouses and villas sit around a shared podium, for a total of 744 apartments, 39 townhouses and five villas plus retail units. Apartments run from studios to four bedrooms, with one- to four-bedroom layouts of 831 sq ft to 2,339 sq ft, and the four-bedroom townhouses are set over three levels with a roof terrace.

Homes are handed over semi-furnished, with soft pastel interiors and kitchens fitted with Siemens appliances; many layouts add a maid's room and walk-in wardrobes. The 24 shared amenities include lap, recreational and children's pools, three gyms, two squash courts, a paddle tennis court, a golf simulator, a cinema room, co-working spaces, a children's day care and a sky garden. Parking is provided for 1,203 cars, 100 of them enabled for EV charging. A landscaped retail plaza sits at street level, and Motor City's gardens, cycle paths and the Dubai Outdoor Kartdrome are nearby.

Union Properties, founded in 1987 and publicly listed, is the developer behind Motor City, Dubai Autodrome and Uptown Mirdif, and has delivered more than 10,000 units in Dubai. Takaya adds a broad spread of apartment sizes and a limited number of townhouses and villas to this established community between major highways. The two towers, Avita and Bella, feature a dynamic flow and terraced edges that offer 360-degree viewing opportunities, blending seamlessly into a lush, landscaped podium that cascades toward a 40-meter wide white sand beach. The PASSO experience is a rich lifestyle journey woven through architecture and nature, offering residents a unique resort and leisure experience within a residential project. The myriad of amenities is carefully distributed across multiple levels, creating various attractions that benefit from the surrounding views. description: Lyra, brought to life by Majid Al Futtaim, stands as a nature‑inspired residential tower that crowns the edge of a meticulously landscaped forest. The structure lifts above a ground level and offers a mix of one‑ and two‑bedroom homes, including garden‑type apartments on the lower tier that open onto private outdoor spaces. Its architectural expression embraces the surrounding greenery, framing views of the Ghaf Woods canopy for every resident. Within the tower, residents enjoy a suite of premium amenities designed for comfort and recreation. The broader community contributes shaded walking trails, thoughtfully arranged parks, active sports fields, dedicated children's play zones, and several pools scattered among the trees. These shared facilities blend seamlessly with the forest setting, encouraging an outdoor‑oriented lifestyle. Interiors are dressed in warm natural hues, featuring open‑plan living areas bathed in light from large glazed panels. Kitchens are equipped with integrated appliances and clever storage solutions, while bedrooms provide built‑in wardrobes and bathrooms showcase contemporary fixtures. The overall finish reflects a calm, modern aesthetic that celebrates natural materials. Location description and benefits Wadi Al Safa 4 lies within Ghaf Woods, a master‑planned forest enclave that forms part of the City of Arabia district. Residents benefit from immediate access to the on‑site Ghaf Woods Mall, a retail hub that supplies everyday necessities. The presence of the Dubai British School nearby adds a reputable educational option for families. Entertainment options such as Global Village and the leisure attractions of City of Arabia sit just beyond the community's borders, offering vibrant cultural experiences. Major thoroughfares including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road intersect close by, delivering swift connections across the emirate. These arterial routes streamline journeys to commercial centres, business districts and recreational spots throughout Dubai. A short drive reaches Downtown Dubai, the iconic Dubai Hills Estate and both of the emirate's airports, ensuring global connectivity. The tranquil, verdant environment attracts families, professionals and investors seeking a balanced lifestyle without sacrificing urban convenience. Tax‑free ownership paired with eligibility for the Dubai Golden Visa fuels steady rental demand and reinforces the area's investment appeal.

description: Binghatti Spectre is a distinctive mixed-use development by Binghatti, introduced under the concept "A Presence Beyond the Visible." Rising above a shared podium, the development comprises two towers of contrasting heights defined by a sculptural and fluid architectural silhouette. The project brings together a selection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, Royal Suites, dedicated office spaces, and retail destinations, creating a contemporary environment that combines residential and commercial living with panoramic views across Dubai. Designed around an active and social lifestyle, Binghatti Spectre offers an extensive collection of leisure and wellness facilities. Residents can enjoy dedicated adult and children's swimming pools, a yoga and aerobics platform, paddle and tennis courts, and a jogging and sprint lane. Family-oriented spaces include a children's play area, comfortable sitting areas, and social nooks, while wellness facilities, lounge platforms, open lawns, and recreational tables including ping-pong provide opportunities for both relaxation and entertainment. The residences are thoughtfully planned across a range of layouts, from efficient studios to spacious three-bedroom homes. Larger residences offer enhanced features such as private pools, sky-open terraces, and dedicated laundry areas, creating a more elevated residential experience. Interiors are organized into distinct living, dining, and kitchen zones, with master suites incorporated into the larger configurations. Modern finishes, quality materials, and contemporary detailing complete the homes, which are delivered unfurnished to allow residents to personalize their living spaces. Location Description & Benefits Located in Al Jaddaf , Binghatti Spectre benefits from an emerging waterfront neighborhood positioned along Dubai Creek. The area occupies a strategic location between the historic districts of Old Dubai and the city's established business and lifestyle destinations, including Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. This central positioning provides convenient access to major road networks such as Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, while Dubai Metro and Creek transport connections further enhance accessibility. Al Jaddaf offers a distinctive combination of heritage, culture, waterfront surroundings, and modern urban development. The neighborhood is connected to Dubai Creek, one of the city's most historically significant waterways, while nearby cultural destinations add to its appeal. The Jameel Arts Centre contributes to the area's growing creative and cultural identity, creating an environment that extends beyond conventional residential living. The community continues to develop as a vibrant residential and commercial destination, with modern apartment buildings, waterfront residences, landscaped walkways, retail outlets, restaurants, and leisure facilities. Its proximity to Dubai International Airport is another major advantage, particularly for frequent travelers and international residents. With its central location, growing waterfront appeal, strong connectivity, and proximity to Dubai's established business and lifestyle districts, Al Jaddaf offers attractive long-term potential for both end-users and investors. Binghatti Spectre combines this strategic setting with distinctive architecture, diverse residence options, and resort-style amenities, creating a contemporary destination designed for modern urban living.

description: Portside Square is a distinctive waterfront development set within the historic Mina Rashid, where contemporary architecture takes inspiration from the movement and rhythm of the sea. Comprising three sculptural towers - Portside Residences I, II, and III - the development is characterised by fluid lines, soft contours, and shimmering façades that interact beautifully with natural light. Its architectural design creates a harmonious relationship between sea, sky, and structure, offering a refined residential environment with open layouts, expansive glazing, and panoramic views. The development presents a lifestyle centred around wellness, leisure, and social connection. Residents can enjoy leisure and lap pools, landscaped decks, a dedicated fitness pavilion, and spa and sauna facilities. Additional amenities include yoga areas, co-working spaces, cinema and games lounges, and a dedicated children's club, creating an environment that caters to different lifestyles and age groups. Outdoor spaces are thoughtfully integrated throughout the community, with jogging paths, landscaped garden courtyards, and marina-facing lounges offering inviting places to relax, exercise, and connect. Equipped kitchens incorporate premium appliances, combining modern functionality with elegant design. Delivered unfurnished, the homes offer residents the flexibility to personalise their interiors while benefiting from a sophisticated architectural foundation and carefully selected finishes. Location Description & Benefits Dubai Maritime City is a distinctive waterfront destination that combines maritime infrastructure, commercial activity, and emerging residential developments. Strategically positioned near Dubai's established urban districts and major port facilities, the area is evolving into a specialised maritime hub while introducing new opportunities for waterfront living. The district has traditionally supported a wide range of marine-related industries, including shipbuilding, vessel maintenance, marine engineering, and maritime services. Its infrastructure includes specialised shipyards, dry docks, and facilities for marine equipment and service providers, alongside educational and training institutions that support the maritime sector. Its strategic position near Dubai's key ports and transport networks provides important connectivity for maritime businesses and international trade. At the same time, its proximity to the city's established districts allows residents and professionals to benefit from access to commercial centres, retail destinations, dining, and everyday conveniences. As Dubai Maritime City continues to develop, the combination of its waterfront setting, specialised commercial infrastructure, and growing residential offering is creating a distinctive urban environment. It presents an interesting proposition for those seeking a contemporary lifestyle within a developing coastal destination, supported by its strategic position within Dubai.

description: Project general facts This is a premium waterfront residential development rising on Dubai Islands, where contemporary architecture meets the calm rhythm of the sea. Designed with refined coastal tones and fluid façades, the project reflects a modern interpretation of island living, defined by openness, light, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Low-density planning enhances privacy and exclusivity, while landscaped gardens and open lounges create a resort-style ambiance shaped by nature and horizon views. The lifestyle is centered around wellness, leisure, and effortless sophistication. Residents are welcomed through a dedicated VIP drop-off area and enjoy access to an extensive collection of curated amenities, including adult and children's swimming pools, a pavilion clubhouse, outdoor yoga and wellness zones, jogging and walking tracks, mixed landscape gardens with sand and gravel concepts, grand tiered seating areas, covered lounges, and open-to-sky garden seating. From cascading water features to outdoor cinema and relaxation decks, every space is designed to evoke a refined island retreat atmosphere. The residences are delivered fully furnished and fully designed, incorporating a smart home system and refined interior detailing accessorized by Hermès. Layouts are bright and airy, emphasizing natural light and a smooth transition between interior and exterior spaces. Duplex residences feature elevated privacy and, in select units, private pools, enhancing the exclusive waterfront experience. Sea Cliff by Imtiaz represents a harmonious blend of architectural elegance, intelligent living, and curated luxury in a serene island setting. Location description and benefits Dubai Islands is a visionary development that epitomizes the luxurious and innovative spirit of Dubai. Strategically located along the coast, this ambitious project features a collection of five man-made islands designed to offer a blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters. The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city. This prime location allows residents and visitors to enjoy the tranquility of island life while being just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, including the iconic landmarks and vibrant districts such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development includes a range of upscale amenities, including luxury hotels, gourmet dining options, high-end retail outlets, and world-class recreational facilities. Dubai Islands is designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, offering everything from serene residential communities to dynamic entertainment hubs. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. With its stunning natural beauty, exceptional amenities, and strategic location, Dubai Islands stands as a premier destination for those seeking an unparalleled lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities. description: Binghatti Skyblade is a striking residential development that redefines contemporary urban living through bold architecture and sophisticated design. Distinguished by its blade-inspired silhouette, crystalline glass façades, satin chrome accents, and sculpted balconies, the tower creates a dynamic architectural statement against Dubai's skyline. The development offers a collection of studios and one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed with open layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and an emphasis on natural light, spaciousness, and seamless interior flow. The development features a carefully curated selection of lifestyle amenities designed to complement modern living. Residents can enjoy rooftop infinity swimming pools, dedicated wellness and spa facilities, fully equipped fitness centres, landscaped recreational areas, and children's play zones. Complemented by thoughtfully designed communal spaces, these facilities create an inviting environment where relaxation, recreation, and social interaction come together. The combination of elevated leisure facilities and contemporary conveniences enhances the overall residential experience. The residences feature modern interiors finished with quality materials and refined detailing. Smart home technology adds convenience and functionality, while equipped kitchens provide practical solutions for everyday living. The apartments are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalise their interiors according to their preferences. Combined with efficient layouts, contemporary finishes, and expansive windows, the homes offer a sophisticated canvas for modern urban living. Location Description and Benefits Downtown Dubai is one of the city's most prestigious and vibrant districts, renowned for its iconic skyline, world-class attractions, and upscale lifestyle. Home to celebrated landmarks such as Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and the Dubai Fountain, the area offers an exceptional blend of retail, dining, entertainment, and hospitality experiences. Its dynamic atmosphere and distinctive urban character make it a sought-after destination for residents, professionals, and international visitors. The district features an impressive selection of luxury residences, premium hotels, fine-dining restaurants, and high-end shopping destinations. From designer boutiques and vibrant cafés to entertainment venues and cultural attractions, Downtown Dubai offers a lifestyle defined by convenience and sophistication. Its pedestrian-friendly areas and access to public transport, including the Dubai Metro, also make it an appealing choice for residents who prefer convenient connections to key destinations across the city. Strategically connected to Sheikh Zayed Road and major road networks, Downtown Dubai provides access to important business and residential districts, including Business Bay and other central areas. Its proximity to commercial hubs, transport links, and everyday amenities supports a well-connected urban lifestyle. With its combination of iconic landmarks, premium facilities, and vibrant city living, Downtown Dubai remains one of the city's most recognisable residential and investment destinations.
