description: Project general facts The Residences by DIFC mark the first residential chapter within the visionary DIFC Zabeel District, redefining contemporary urban living in the very heart of Dubai. Comprising two architecturally striking towers with sculptural silhouettes, the project introduces a refined residential destination seamlessly integrated into a dynamic mixed-use environment. Designed as an extension of DIFC's prestigious legacy, the development blends business, culture, lifestyle, and leisure into a cohesive urban ecosystem, offering residents iconic views across Dubai's most prominent landmarks. Residents of The Residences by DIFC enjoy a carefully curated collection of premium, hotel-inspired amenities designed to elevate everyday living. These include resort-style swimming pools, wellness and fitness facilities, dedicated yoga and relaxation spaces, and elegant residents' lounges for socialising or quiet retreat. Thoughtfully designed communal areas provide spaces for work, leisure, and connection, while landscaped terraces and outdoor zones create a sense of calm within the urban setting. Complementing the private amenities, the project is enriched by direct access to the pedestrian boulevard, high-end retail and dining, and the Inner Circle green loop - a continuous landscaped pathway encouraging walking, wellness, and community interaction. The residential collection features refined apartments and duplex penthouses with intelligently planned layouts that prioritise space, light, and comfort. Interiors are defined by a timeless aesthetic, premium materials, and a sophisticated palette that reflects the understated elegance of DIFC. With seamless connectivity to Gate District, Emirates Towers, the Museum of the Future, and Dubai World Trade Centre via the Future Loop, The Residences by DIFC offer a rare opportunity to live at the intersection of prestige, connectivity, and elevated urban lifestyle. Location description and benefits DIFC Zabeel District is a urban extension of the Dubai International Financial Centre, positioned at the intersection of Dubai's most established business, lifestyle, and residential destinations. Strategically located between DIFC, Downtown Dubai, Zabeel Park, and the World Trade Centre corridor, the district benefits from direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road and key city arteries. This prime positioning places residents within minutes of Dubai's financial core, cultural landmarks, and global business hubs, while maintaining a sense of exclusivity and urban refinement. The district is conceived as a fully integrated, mixed-use urban quarter that seamlessly blends residential, commercial, retail, and lifestyle components. Thoughtfully planned pedestrian routes, shaded boulevards, landscaped public spaces, and curated retail and dining destinations form the backbone of the neighborhood. The master plan emphasizes walkability, connectivity, and a human-scale urban experience, transforming DIFC Zabeel District into a vibrant, self-sustained environment that supports both professional and everyday living. DIFC Zabeel District is designed to cater to a cosmopolitan audience seeking a dynamic yet balanced lifestyle. The area combines the prestige and global reputation of DIFC with contemporary urban living, offering proximity to offices, cultural venues, hospitality, and leisure destinations within a single cohesive district. With its emphasis on quality placemaking, integrated amenities, and long-term urban value, DIFC Zabeel District is positioned as one of Dubai's most forward-looking and desirable central neighborhoods.

title: Sector 3, Dubai
description: Reference: GTWW-T1353. The development located in Business Bay, Dubai, was conceived as an ultra-luxurious residential tower that asserts itself as one of the tallest and most exclusive housing structures in the world. The building features a striking architecture, inspired by the universe of high jewellery, which is reflected in sculptural shapes, metal inserts, worked decorative elements and meticulous attention to every aesthetic detail. The concept favours not only visual grandeur, but also the creation of sophisticated interiors, highly customisable and developed to offer a level of comfort and refinement rarely found in the residential market. The composition of the tower integrates different categories of housing, aimed at diversified profiles of residents. The initial typologies include two-and-a-half-bedroom residences, designed with functional layouts and a contemporary language, while always maintaining high standards of materials and finishes. Evolving in the range are three-bedroom units, which offer larger areas, harmoniously distributed rooms and rooms with large windows that allow unimpeded views of the Dubai skyline. On the upper levels, typologies of a frankly exclusive character emerge, such as the suspended mansions of four and six bedrooms, which occupy generous areas and provide a true experience of an independent house within a vertical tower. Some of these units include a private pool, cinema rooms, play areas, reading spaces and areas for wellness activities, such as rooms prepared for massages or fully equipped gyms. These residences are also distinguished by the high number of private parking spaces, which can vary between four and twelve, ensuring safety and practicality. At the top of the structure are the most emblematic residences of the project: large penthouses designed in full floors or in duplexes, with exceptional surfaces that far exceed the typical dimensions of luxury apartments. These units include infinity pools with panoramic views, formal and informal dining areas, main kitchens and secondary kitchens for service, private gyms, games rooms, offices, private lounges, suites with walk-in wardrobes, bathrooms covered in noble materials and protected outdoor areas to enjoy the view over the city. In some cases, residents have a private lift with direct access to the interior of the unit, ensuring the highest level of privacy. The building offers an extensive set of amenities that reinforce its position as a reference in the luxury real estate sector. These include large-design outdoor pools, a spa with treatment rooms, a sauna, a Turkish bath and relaxation areas, a gym equipped with state-of-the-art technology, lounges reserved for residents, meeting rooms and social spaces designed for private events. The tower also has concierge services available daily, valet assistance, permanent security staff, high-standard reception and advanced access control systems. The common areas have been carefully planned, using premium materials such as marble, worked metals and architectural lighting, creating an atmosphere of sophistication and exclusivity from the main atrium to the upper floors. The location in Business Bay guarantees a privileged connection to strategic areas of Dubai, such as Downtown, Dubai Canal, financial centres, cultural areas and some of the city's most popular gastronomic and commercial destinations. The proximity to the main traffic routes offers quick accessibility to the airport, beaches and other central neighbourhoods, making the development an ideal option for both permanent residence and investment. Taken together, this tower represents a unique proposition in Dubai's real estate landscape: it combines extremely refined design, typologies adapted to different lifestyles, international standard services and a highly prestigious location. description: Waterfront Apartments in a Prestigious Marina Complex in Mina Rashid Dubai Mina Rashid is one of Dubai's most distinctive waterfront districts, combining the city's maritime heritage with modern coastal living. Once known as Dubai's main port, the area is now being transformed into a prestigious residential destination featuring a world-class yacht marina and contemporary seaside developments. Surrounded by the waters of the Arabian Gulf, Mina Rashid offers a refined lifestyle with open views, marina access, and strong connections to the sea, making it an attractive location for both living and investment. The Mina Rashid are located near the Queen Elizabeth 2 Hotel and the historic Al Fahidi district. The project offers direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road and is approximately 15 minutes from Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa, and 10 minutes from Dubai Maritime City. This location provides the advantage of a peaceful waterfront environment while maintaining convenient connections to the city's major business and lifestyle hubs. The project consists of three modern residential towers distinguished by fluid architectural lines and contemporary design. Residents benefit from a wide range of resort-style "Pavilion" amenities, including a leisure swimming pool with relaxation areas, a fully equipped fitness center, and a dedicated residents' clubhouse. Additional facilities such as an outdoor cinema lounge, yoga and pilates studios, an aromatherapy wellness room, and co-working spaces support both an active and comfortable lifestyle. The project is designed to combine social living areas with private relaxation spaces, creating a balanced and functional residential environment. The project offers a variety of layout options ranging from studios to spacious 3- and 4-bedroom apartments. The interiors are designed with neutral color palettes, premium natural materials, and floor-to-ceiling windows that maximize natural light and enhance the connection with the surrounding waterfront environment. title: Sector 3, Dubai
description: Reference: GTWW-T1286. It presents a large-scale, ultra-luxury residential tower located in the heart of Downtown Dubai, an architectural landmark that combines futuristic design, exceptional proportions and high-quality materials. Designed according to a principle of sensory purity, the project combines emotion and rationality, offering residential units that privilege serenity, natural light and the harmonious integration between form and functionality. Located in one of the most prestigious areas of the city, the building is just a few minutes from the main landmarks: 3 kilometres from the Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Mall, 7 minutes from the Dubai International Financial Centre, 3 minutes from the Dubai Opera and 15 minutes from the public beach of Jumeirah. The strategic position between Downtown Dubai and Business Bay ensures expansive and unobstructed views, as well as immediate access to the city's main thoroughfares. The tower rises to 341 meters in height and consists of 3 underground floors, ground floor, 5 podium floors and 65 upper floors, which include 51 residential floors and 3 dedicated to amenities, in addition to a health club and infinity pool. The project includes a total of 150 units, including two- and three-bedroom suites and four, five- and six-bedroom penthouses, including duplex and triplex options. Units can be purchased furnished or unfurnished and ownership is freehold. The ceilings have a height of 4.2 meters, reinforcing the spacious and sophisticated character of the interior spaces. The interior design highlights the use of noble materials such as travertine, walnut wood, selected marble, technical glass, chrome and handcrafted elements. The elegant lines and fluid geometry reflect a contemporary approach that favours comfort, refinement and visual balance. In addition to aesthetic care, the building incorporates smart sustainability solutions, including photovoltaic panels integrated into the façade, advanced air conditioning and acoustic systems, charging points for electric vehicles and planning aimed at obtaining environmental certification. The complex offers a full range of services and amenities, such as panoramic pools, private pools in specific units, spa, gym, concierge services, valet, housekeeping, exclusive parking for penthouses, leisure areas and home automation systems. These services ensure a highly differentiated standard of living oriented towards absolute comfort. The two-bedroom typologies vary between 170 m² and 305 m², depending on the floor, and may include a private pool, large balconies, equipped kitchens and, in some cases, a maid. The three-bedroom units stand out for their generous areas, the possibility of a private pool and double kitchens. The penthouses, with amplified areas and unique layouts, include features such as cinema rooms, games rooms, private gyms, jacuzzis, double closets, indoor and outdoor pools, massage rooms and spaces designed to provide a residential experience at the level of the highest international standards. This development represents a paradigmatic landmark of contemporary architecture in Dubai, combining technical innovation, refined aesthetics and unparalleled views. It is a product aimed at buyers looking for exclusivity, distinction, advanced engineering and a truly exceptional lifestyle. #ref:8989

description: Apartments with Payment Plan Until Completion in Al Reem Island Al Reem Island is one of Abu Dhabis most prestigious and sought-after waterfront communities, offering a perfect blend of urban sophistication and serene coastal living. Strategically located just minutes from the city center, this island destination features a wide range of luxury residential towers, high-end commercial spaces, and vibrant retail areas. Residents enjoy world-class amenities including private beaches, marinas, parks, schools, and resort-style facilities all set against stunning sea views and a modern skyline. With ongoing developments and strong investment potential, Al Reem Island continues to attract discerning homeowners and investors alike. Apartments for sale in Abu Dhabi, are situated 12 minutes from Abu Dhabi Mall, 13 minutes from Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi, 14 minutes from international schools and Downtown Abu Dhabi and 30 minutes from Abu Dhabi International Airport 50 minutes from Dubai. The project is a fully integrated mixed-use development set in the heart of Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi, offering a vertical community lifestyle with a smart, modern living concept. Designed with contemporary elegance and practical luxury, the development features sleek architecture inspired by the oceans fluidity and natural rhythm. It includes residential units, offices, retail spaces, clinics, pharmacies, and sports centres across three towers and podium levels. Residents enjoy a wealth of amenities including a large swimming pool, kids pool, state-of-the-art gymnasiums, shaded seating areas, and vibrant kids play zones. Each unit is equipped with private balconies or terraces, central air conditioning, built-in wardrobes, double-glazed windows, and high-quality kitchen fittings. description: "Samana Park Meadows is developed by Samana in Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC). The building has two basement levels, a ground floor and 14 floors above, and contains studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments. Studios start from 528 sq ft and one-bedroom homes from 898 sq ft, while two-bedroom homes measure from 1,152 sq ft to 1,278 sq ft. Studio, one- and two-bedroom types are each offered in a layout with a private pool, and the design pairs clean lines with extensive glazing. Global Village, Dubai Outlet Mall, IMG Worlds and Fairgreen International School are about 10 to 15 minutes away, Mirdif City Centre and Dubai International Airport 15 to 20 minutes, and Downtown Dubai and the Burj Khalifa 20 to 25 minutes. The payment plan is weighted towards completion, with 20% on booking, 20% during construction and 60% on handover, which is expected in Q3 2027. title: Peace Lagoons
description:
Peace Lagoons is a residential development by Peace Homes Development in Dubai Land Residence Complex. Its building rises above a podium, with 17 residential floors and a rooftop level. The project offers studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments. Balconies and a private pool in every residence bring outdoor space into the design, while a shared lagoon forms the centre of the development.

Interiors feature Italian ceramics and equipped kitchens with German appliances. Shared facilities include indoor and outdoor swimming pools, gyms, a spa and sauna, a cinema and a games area. A children's play area and yoga spaces add further options for recreation. The development also includes a volleyball court and a planned 30,000 sq ft shopping mall, bringing retail space into the residential complex.

The project suits buyers looking for an apartment with its own pool and access to shared leisure facilities in Dubai Land Residence Complex. The payment schedule extends beyond handover, allowing part of the purchase to be paid after completion. Handover is expected in Q2 2027. The project is DLD registered, with an escrow account at Bank Of Sharjah.

Inserted in one of the most central and valued areas of the city, it guarantees quick access to the main points of interest, such as the Dubai Mall, Downtown Dubai, DIFC, Business Bay and Dubai International Airport, making it ideal for both residence and investment. description: The Willows Residences is a limited-edition masterpiece meticulously crafted by SCC Vertex, offering a collection of luxurious apartments that harmoniously blend contemporary design with timeless elegance. This six-story marvel redefines modern living within a low-density community, featuring thoughtfully curated amenities including a rooftop pool deck, a state-of-the-art gym, and lush gardens. With panoramic vistas and bespoke interiors that balance earthy aesthetics with refined functionality, this architectural gem embodies the essence of exclusivity and effortless luxury. The development offers an impressive array of amenities designed to inspire and delight, including a rooftop pool deck that provides a serene retreat with breathtaking views. Residents can maintain their wellness routine in the state-of-the-art gym or enjoy the tranquility of lush gardens that create a peaceful oasis. Every amenity has been carefully curated to promote well-being, relaxation, and a vibrant community lifestyle. Each residence features contemporary light-filled interiors with expansive windows, soaring ceilings, and open spaces that create an inviting atmosphere filled with natural light. The kitchens are equipped with premium appliances including a multi-burner gas top, built-in dishwasher, and oven, complemented by quartz countertops and innovative storage solutions. Sleek flooring, LED lighting, double-glazed windows, and high-efficiency air conditioning systems ensure a modern, polished look while maintaining energy efficiency and comfort throughout every season. Location description and benefits This prestigious development is situated in Meydan, an extraordinary community in the heart of Dubai known for its blend of luxury, sophistication, and world-class amenities. The area offers a unique living experience that combines urban convenience with a tranquil and scenic environment across its expansive landscape. The community is renowned for its iconic racecourse, which hosts prestigious events including the Dubai World Cup, creating an aura of excitement and elegance that attracts enthusiasts from around the world. The neighborhood features expansive parks, landscaped gardens, and tree-lined boulevards that create a serene and refreshing environment for residents to enjoy leisurely walks, bike rides, and picnics. The abundance of open spaces provides opportunities for outdoor activities and social gatherings, fostering a strong sense of community and well-being. The area's thoughtful design integrates green spaces throughout, ensuring that nature is always within reach. The community's central location offers excellent connectivity to the rest of Dubai, with easy access to major highways and public transportation networks. Residents can conveniently explore the city's vibrant attractions, business districts, and cultural landmarks. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of luxury living, natural beauty, and urban accessibility, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most prestigious communities.

description: Burj Binghatti is an iconic ultra-luxury residential tower that represents a bold architectural statement within Dubai's skyline. Rising over 112 storeys, the development is distinguished by its striking crown-inspired pinnacle, created in collaboration with the renowned luxury watch and jewellery brand Jacob & Co. Its extraordinary architectural identity combines visionary design with an exclusive residential concept, positioning the tower as a landmark destination for luxury living. The project features an exceptional collection of two- and three-bedroom suites, alongside prestigious penthouses and sky villas, each designed to offer expansive interiors, panoramic views, and an elevated residential experience. Designed around privacy, exclusivity, and refined luxury, Burj Binghatti offers a lifestyle that extends beyond conventional high-rise living. Its premium residential spaces are thoughtfully planned to provide comfort, sophistication, and exceptional city views. Among its signature offerings are the Fleur de Jardin Sky Villas, featuring half-floor layouts across the upper levels and breathtaking 180-degree views of iconic landmarks, including Burj Khalifa and Dubai Creek. These exclusive residences create an extraordinary setting for those seeking privacy and distinction at the highest level. The interiors reflect an uncompromising approach to quality, featuring premium materials, sophisticated finishes, and meticulous attention to detail. Each residence is designed to create a timeless atmosphere where elegance meets functionality. Equipped kitchens provide modern convenience, while the unfurnished delivery allows homeowners to personalize their interiors according to their individual preferences. From expansive layouts to carefully selected finishes, every element contributes to a distinctive luxury living experience. Location Description & Benefits Located in Business Bay , Burj Binghatti occupies a prestigious address within one of Dubai's most established residential and commercial districts. Positioned alongside the Dubai Canal and just minutes from Downtown Dubai, the area is recognized for its impressive skyline, contemporary architecture, luxury hotels, and premium residential developments. Its central positioning offers convenient access to major destinations, including DIFC, Sheikh Zayed Road, and Dubai International Airport. Business Bay offers a vibrant lifestyle supported by an extensive selection of restaurants, cafés, luxury hotels, retail outlets, and leisure destinations. The Dubai Canal waterfront adds a scenic dimension to the neighbourhood, with promenades and walking paths providing opportunities for outdoor recreation and relaxation. Residents can also enjoy access to fitness centres, wellness facilities, and landscaped public spaces, creating a balance between the energy of city living and peaceful waterfront surroundings. The district has developed into a major business and lifestyle destination, attracting professionals, entrepreneurs, and international residents. Its proximity to Downtown Dubai, established commercial hubs, and key transport routes contributes to its continued residential appeal. Business Bay also benefits from a diverse rental market, supported by demand for centrally located homes and convenient access to Dubai's business districts. description: Waterfront Apartments in a Prestigious Marina Complex in Mina Rashid Dubai Mina Rashid is one of Dubai's most distinctive waterfront districts, combining the city's maritime heritage with modern coastal living. Once known as Dubai's main port, the area is now being transformed into a prestigious residential destination featuring a world-class yacht marina and contemporary seaside developments. Surrounded by the waters of the Arabian Gulf, Mina Rashid offers a refined lifestyle with open views, marina access, and strong connections to the sea, making it an attractive location for both living and investment. The Mina Rashid are located near the Queen Elizabeth 2 Hotel and the historic Al Fahidi district. The project offers direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road and is approximately 15 minutes from Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa, and 10 minutes from Dubai Maritime City. This location provides the advantage of a peaceful waterfront environment while maintaining convenient connections to the city's major business and lifestyle hubs. The project consists of three modern residential towers distinguished by fluid architectural lines and contemporary design. Residents benefit from a wide range of resort-style "Pavilion" amenities, including a leisure swimming pool with relaxation areas, a fully equipped fitness center, and a dedicated residents' clubhouse. Additional facilities such as an outdoor cinema lounge, yoga and pilates studios, an aromatherapy wellness room, and co-working spaces support both an active and comfortable lifestyle. The project is designed to combine social living areas with private relaxation spaces, creating a balanced and functional residential environment. The project offers a variety of layout options ranging from studios to spacious 3- and 4-bedroom apartments. The interiors are designed with neutral color palettes, premium natural materials, and floor-to-ceiling windows that maximize natural light and enhance the connection with the surrounding waterfront environment. description: Set on the 25th floor of the five-star Radisson Blu Hotel RAK Central, this corner Studio + Living suite brings together 708.37 sq ft (65.81 m²), a substantial private balcony and an outlook spanning the sea, landscaped areas and the surrounding community. The Type 1 plan is arranged as a sequence of defined spaces rather than one undivided room. The entrance opens into a curved living room, creating a composed place to relax or receive a guest away from the bed. A central passage leads past the full bathroom to the sleeping area, which connects directly with the balcony. The project plan shows an approximately 3.2 by 7.3 metre living room, a 4.2 by 3.4 metre sleeping area, a 3.3 by 2.9 metre bathroom and a 4.2 by 3.4 metre balcony. Dimensions are indicative and remain subject to the final sale documents. This is an important distinction for buyers comparing hotel property with conventional apartments. The suite is designed as hotel accommodation and the supplied plan does not show a private kitchen or dedicated dining area. Its space is concentrated instead on a generous lounge, a defined sleeping zone, a full bathroom and outdoor living. Dining is delivered through the wider hotel setting, including the specialty restaurant and rooftop pool bar identified in the project material. The interior concept is composed and contemporary. Warm timber, pale stone, tailored lighting and broad glazing establish a calm Radisson Blu character. The progression from lounge to sleeping zone gives the suite a more considered rhythm than a conventional open-plan studio, while its high-floor corner position places light and outlook at the centre of the experience. Project visuals communicate the proposed design direction; final finishes, furniture and equipment must be checked against the contractual specification. The hotel amenity programme is designed around hospitality, wellness, business and leisure. It includes a rooftop swimming pool and pool bar, specialty restaurant, spa and sauna, gymnasium, business lounge and grand ballroom. A padel court, children's club and play areas, children's pool, outdoor cinema and barbecue areas add further depth to the guest experience. RAK Central positions the hotel between Ras Al Khaimah's commercial centre and its resort corridor. Al Hamra Mall is approximately five minutes away, Al Hamra Golf Club seven minutes away, Al Marjan Island eight minutes away and Wynn Al Marjan Island around ten minutes away. Ras Al Khaimah International Airport is approximately fifteen minutes away, while Dubai International Airport is around forty-five minutes away. Drive times are indicative and depend on traffic. For an international investor, the proposition rests on identifiable features rather than a forecast return: a 25th-floor corner position, sea views, one of the Hotel's larger Studio + Living formats, a globally recognised hospitality brand and a phased 50/50 payment structure. The plan begins with 10% on booking, followed by eight instalments of 5% through month twenty. The remaining 50% is due on completion, expected in Q4 2029 subject to the governing sale documents. Hotel-operation terms, owner-use provisions, service charges, furniture schedules and any revenue arrangements should be reviewed before commitment. Tropical Riviera International Realty advises international buyers throughout the acquisition. The brokerage verifies the selected accommodation, compares layouts, clarifies the payment structure and coordinates reservation documents across jurisdictions and time zones. Its cross-border advisory is led by Bhavesh Koonja, REALTOR and Certified International Property Specialist. Contact Tropical Riviera for the specific floor plan, current availability, payment schedule and complete reservation pack.

Surrounded by crystal-clear waters and exclusive developments, it offers the perfect blend of privacy, luxury, and convenience. Residents will enjoy close proximity to vibrant leisure hubs, high-end retail, fine dining, and some of the capitals most iconic landmarksmaking it an exceptional address for elevated living. Apartments for sale in Abu Dhabi, are located 7 minutes from GEMS American School, 11 minutes from Abu Dhabi Golf Club, 15 minutes from local hospitals and clinics, 16 minutes from Al Raha Mall and Zayed International Airport, 18 minutes from Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, and 20 minutes from Yas Island. 45 minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport, 60 minutes from Dubai Downtown. Introducing the worlds first Brabus-branded luxury island, a bold new chapter in elite waterfront living. This landmark development features four architecturally striking 13-storey towers and 96 private villas, set on an exclusive island within Abu Dhabis prestigious Al Seef District. Designed to reflect the signature power, precision, and elegance of the Brabus brand, the island delivers a lifestyle of unmatched sophistication. Residents will enjoy a wealth of world-class amenities including a private marina, signature beach club, infinity-edge swimming pools, state-of-the-art fitness centers, wellness and spa retreats, cycling and jogging tracks, landscaped gardens, childrens play areas, and gourmet dining venues. Additional comforts include 24-hour security, concierge service, and direct access to pristine waterfront views, creating a private sanctuary that blends performance-driven living with timeless luxury. The project offers a refined selection of 2-, 3-, and 4-bedroom residences, each thoughtfully designed to reflect a high standard of contemporary luxury. Interiors are finished with premium materials and crafted for both comfort and elegance, featuring spacious layouts, en-suite bedrooms, and expansive private balconies or terraces. Each unit comes equipped with fully fitted kitchens that include high-quality white goods, along with sleek cabinetry and countertops that complement the modern design. Bedrooms are outfitted with built-in wardrobes, while all bathrooms are fully tiled and include high-end vanity units, mirrors, and walk-in showers. Double-glazed windows enhance natural light while ensuring insulation and energy efficiency, and the entire living space is cooled by a central air conditioning system. High-speed internet is supported by satellite and fiber optic connectivity, ensuring seamless digital living in a setting that blends luxury with everyday functionality. AUH-00014

Conceptualized around the calming element of water, the development features a custom internal canal network that winds organically throughout the community. The landscape is deeply rooted in regional heritage, enriched with native Ghaf trees, date palm promenades, and coastal mangroves that create a tranquil microclimate. The modern architectural forms harmoniously incorporate classic elements such as mashrabiya motifs, delivering a refined living experience that celebrates both tradition and contemporary elegance The development boasts an exceptionally strategic location with effortless connectivity to Abu Dhabi's key entertainment, business, and transport hubs. , are situated just 5 minutes from Zayed International Airport and 7 minutes from Etihad Arena. Wellness facilities include dedicated fitness centers in each residential building, panoramic rooftop swimming pools, a serene spa, jogging tracks, cycling paths, and shaded courtyard seating. Landscaped cluster gardens, dedicated children's play areas, and an elegant community lounge offer inviting spaces for outdoor relaxation and social gatherings. The apartments are masterfully designed with open-concept layouts, high ceilings, and expansive floor-to-ceiling double-glazed windows that fill the interiors with natural light while connecting rooms to the surrounding water scenery. Each apartment features a spacious private balcony or terrace offering views of the internal canal network, landscaped green valleys, or the marina. description: Exclusive Beachfront Apartments with Installment on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a site of significant historical and ecological importance. Archaeological excavations have uncovered the oldest known pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf on the island, dating back to the late 6th or early 7th century CE. Additionally, the discovery of an Eastern Christian monastery from the same period provides insight into the region's diverse cultural heritage. The island is also home to one of the largest remaining colonies of Socotra cormorants, highlighting its environmental significance. Recognizing its potential, the Umm Al Quwain government has initiated a development project to introduce leisure, hotel, and residential properties to Siniyah Island, aiming to blend its rich history with modern amenities. , are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious seaside lifestyle, set amidst lush landscapes and serene surroundings. It seamlessly integrates natural beauty and refined architectural design, boasting pristine beaches with velvety white sands and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Residents enjoy direct beach and lagoon access, expansive views of the Arabian Gulf, and lush green vistas overlooking a meticulously designed 18-hole golf course. The development features premium amenities including an infinity swimming pool, an outdoor cinema, a state-of-the-art fitness centre, and multiple children's play areas. For leisure and relaxation, landscaped parks, tranquil gardens, and a vibrant community centre provide perfect spaces to unwind. Additionally, thrill-seekers can indulge in exhilarating water sports such as scuba diving, snorkeling, kite surfing, and paddleboarding. The retail boulevard offers a sensory feast with charming cafes and gourmet dining, enhancing the vibrant community atmosphere. Exclusive services such as a yacht club, a shopping mall, luxury resorts, and a helipad further elevate the sophisticated lifestyle experience provided by this prestigious island residence. The project offers elegantly designed interiors across a selection of premium 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and duplexes, carefully crafted to blend modern comfort with sophisticated aesthetics. Each residence features contemporary layouts enhanced by spacious living areas and meticulous attention to detail. The interiors are equipped with stylish fitted wardrobes and fully integrated kitchen appliances, providing residents with convenience and luxury. Tower A exclusively offers fully furnished units, thoughtfully curated with tasteful furnishings and décor for immediate comfort and sophisticated living from day one. Towers B, C, and D present semi-furnished residences, allowing flexibility for personal touches to complement the refined interiors. Every apartment has been designed to create a harmonious living space that emphasizes both elegance and functionality, offering residents an exceptional lifestyle experience in a vibrant coastal setting. title: The World Islands, Dubai
description: Project general facts It is a private island resort community conceived as a curated collection of waterfront homes, where every journey begins with a sea crossing to a dedicated arrival jetty. Low-rise residential buildings with sweeping curved terraces and layered, sculpted balconies wrap around sandy beaches, lagoons and boat moorings, so that most homes look directly onto open water and the city skyline. The residential offering ranges from compact studios to one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments, crowned by a limited collection of exclusive penthouses and complemented by a separate villa collection of Ocean Floating Villas set directly on the water, Light House Villas and Tree Villas framed by landscaped gardens. Island life is organised around leisure by the sea. Residents have access to a refined beach club with loungers and shaded cabanas, several swimming pools, a floating restaurant with panoramic water views, a retail promenade designed as a lifestyle destination, a dedicated fitness studio and a kids play area built around a central tree sculpture. Larger residences enjoy wraparound open-air balconies with private plunge pools or jacuzzis, outdoor lounges, sunbeds, outdoor dining zones and wellness corners, while a dedicated welcome centre marks the start of the resident and guest journey to the island. Interiors follow a calm resort palette of sand, ivory and warm timber, with marble surfaces, soft curved furniture and floor-to-ceiling glazing that opens living rooms and bedrooms to the sea. Open-plan living and dining areas lead to show kitchens, master bedrooms are paired with walk-in dressing areas and bathrooms, and the largest homes add maid rooms, storage and separate powder rooms, creating a polished, hotel-inspired setting throughout. Location description and benefits The World Islands is an exclusive man-made archipelago set off the Jumeirah coastline, where individual islands are arranged in the outline of a world map. The location offers a rare sense of seclusion while staying within sight of the city: Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah, Jumeirah Bay and the Downtown Dubai skyline all sit on the horizon, and the surrounding waters are lined with some of the most prestigious resort and residential addresses in Dubai. Access to the islands is by sea, with boat transfers and water taxis connecting to marinas and jetties along the Jumeirah coast, and private yacht arrivals adding to the resort-style experience. Once ashore on the mainland, Jumeirah Beach Road and Sheikh Zayed Road link residents to Downtown Dubai, DIFC, Dubai Marina and both international airports, while premium schools, clinics, beach clubs, fine dining and the leading shopping malls of the city are all within easy reach. The World Islands is a freehold destination open to international buyers, positioned at the very top of the Dubai luxury market. The scarcity of private island homes, strong appeal to high-net-worth buyers and the steady demand for exclusive holiday homes and premium short-stay rentals make the location well suited both for a personal seaside retreat and for long-term capital preservation. Contact: Mayank

title: Sector 3, Dubai
description: Reference: GTWW-T1288. It presents a large-scale, ultra-luxury residential tower located in the heart of Downtown Dubai, an architectural landmark that combines futuristic design, exceptional proportions and high-quality materials. Designed according to a principle of sensory purity, the project combines emotion and rationality, offering residential units that privilege serenity, natural light and the harmonious integration between form and functionality. Located in one of the most prestigious areas of the city, the building is just a few minutes from the main landmarks: 3 kilometres from the Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Mall, 7 minutes from the Dubai International Financial Centre, 3 minutes from the Dubai Opera and 15 minutes from the public beach of Jumeirah. The strategic position between Downtown Dubai and Business Bay ensures expansive and unobstructed views, as well as immediate access to the city's main thoroughfares. The tower rises to 341 meters in height and consists of 3 underground floors, ground floor, 5 podium floors and 65 upper floors, which include 51 residential floors and 3 dedicated to amenities, in addition to a health club and infinity pool. The project includes a total of 150 units, including two- and three-bedroom suites and four, five- and six-bedroom penthouses, including duplex and triplex options. Units can be purchased furnished or unfurnished and ownership is freehold. The ceilings have a height of 4.2 meters, reinforcing the spacious and sophisticated character of the interior spaces. The interior design highlights the use of noble materials such as travertine, walnut wood, selected marble, technical glass, chrome and handcrafted elements. The elegant lines and fluid geometry reflect a contemporary approach that favours comfort, refinement and visual balance. In addition to aesthetic care, the building incorporates smart sustainability solutions, including photovoltaic panels integrated into the façade, advanced air conditioning and acoustic systems, charging points for electric vehicles and planning aimed at obtaining environmental certification. The complex offers a full range of services and amenities, such as panoramic pools, private pools in specific units, spa, gym, concierge services, valet, housekeeping, exclusive parking for penthouses, leisure areas and home automation systems. These services ensure a highly differentiated standard of living oriented towards absolute comfort. The two-bedroom typologies vary between 170 m² and 305 m², depending on the floor, and may include a private pool, large balconies, equipped kitchens and, in some cases, a maid. The three-bedroom units stand out for their generous areas, the possibility of a private pool and double kitchens. The penthouses, with amplified areas and unique layouts, include features such as cinema rooms, games rooms, private gyms, jacuzzis, double closets, indoor and outdoor pools, massage rooms and spaces designed to provide a residential experience at the level of the highest international standards. This development represents a paradigmatic landmark of contemporary architecture in Dubai, combining technical innovation, refined aesthetics and unparalleled views. It is a product aimed at buyers looking for exclusivity, distinction, advanced engineering and a truly exceptional lifestyle. #ref:8989_3

description: Apartments in the World's Second-Tallest Building with Installments in Dubai Dubai's Trade Centre area is a prestigious business and residential hub located along Sheikh Zayed Road, at the heart of the city. Known for its iconic skyline, it hosts the Dubai World Trade Centre, a major venue for global exhibitions and conferences. The area offers excellent connectivity via the metro, proximity to Downtown Dubai, and a mix of upscale hotels, office towers, and residential buildings. Its strategic location, vibrant atmosphere, and access to dining, retail, and business facilities make it one of Dubai's most sought-after addresses for professionals, investors, and urban lifestyle seekers. Luxury are located just 4 minutes from the Metro Station, 6 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, 8 minutes from Dubai International Financial Centre, 10 minutes from the Museum of the Future, 12 minutes from City Walk, 15 minutes from Dubai Frame, 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport, 22 minutes from Burj Al Arab, 25 minutes from Dubai Marina, and 28 minutes from Palm Jumeirah. Rising 725 meters along Sheikh Zayed Road, this architectural marvel redefines ultra-luxury living with its radiant glass facades and elegant structural form. As the world's second-tallest building, it comprises over 131 floors and sets multiple global records, including the highest hotel lobby (498 m), observation deck (649 m), occupied hotel room (534 m), nightclub (577 m), cinema (310 m), spa (416 m), and supermarket (310 m), along with Dubai's highest restaurant at 554 meters. The project features freehold apartments, holiday homes, and opulent penthouses, complemented by a 7-star hotel with seven culturally themed suites. Interiors are crafted with premium materials such as marble flooring, stone countertops, and bespoke lighting, offering panoramic views of the sea and city skyline. Residents enjoy access to world-class amenities including indoor and outdoor pools, spa treatment rooms, Moroccan hammam, steam rooms, saunas, a yoga studio, a high-tech gym, and a dedicated wellness center. Leisure facilities include a cinema, billiards room, chess area, kids' play zone, and an adrenaline floor featuring a record-breaking rock climbing wall. A seven-floor luxury retail podium offers an exclusive, invite-only shopping experience, while Michelin-starred dining and themed restaurants inspired by global cuisines deliver a culinary journey like no other-creating a lifestyle of unmatched refinement and sophistication. The project offers exquisitely designed 1, 2, and 3-bedroom freehold apartments and holiday homes, meticulously crafted to embody refined elegance and modern functionality. Interiors are characterized by expansive layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and breathtaking skyline and sea views. Each residence features high-quality marble flooring, stone countertops, warm wood finishes, and ambient lighting that creates an inviting and tranquil atmosphere. Bedrooms include fitted wardrobes designed for both style and storage efficiency, while kitchens come fully equipped with premium white goods and sleek cabinetry for a seamless culinary experience. Bathrooms are spa-inspired, with Italian marble tubs, double vanities, and rainfall showers that elevate daily rituals into moments of indulgence. From sculptural pendant lighting to plush textures and custom detailing, every element of the interior design is tailored to provide a luxurious yet comfortable lifestyle, where sophistication meets everyday ease. title: Sector 3, Dubai
description: Reference: GTWW-T1207. A new residential landmark stands in the heart of Dubai's Sheikh Zayed Road, within the prestigious Business Bay district. It is a modern and exclusive community consisting of six elegant towers, surrounded by elevated parks, a technology shopping centre, premium offices and a full collection of lifestyle amenities. With stunning views of the Arabian Sea, Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT) and Dubai Marina, this development redefines the concept of living, working and relaxing in one space. The expansive leisure deck, perched on the podium, combines indoor comfort with the energy of outdoor spaces, providing a network of experiences designed for convenience, community and tranquillity, from the clubhouse and gym to the cinema and gardens. The project features interconnected towers with sixty floors, offering one- and two-bedroom apartments with private balconies and panoramic views. It features approximately 1,225 residential units and 175,000 square feet of premium offices, as well as modern co-working areas and a business centre accessible directly by lift. The double-height main lobby has dedicated elevators to each tower. Delivery is scheduled for December 2029. Among the outdoor amenities are several swimming pools, including children's, semi-Olympic, leisure and jacuzzi, as well as outdoor exercise spaces, a jogging track, a mini golf course, a football field, a cricket batting area and a callisthenics gym. There is also an open-air cinema, picnic and event areas, themed gardens ornamental, sensory, aromatic and medicinal , grassy amphitheatre, barbecue spaces and a dog park. Inside, residents have a fully equipped gym, yoga studio, sauna and Turkish bath with changing rooms, multifunctional lounge, children's area, library, leisure lounge, fitness and spinning studio, indoor cinema, meditation room and relaxation areas, as well as a complete business centre. The apartments are delivered with a fully equipped kitchen with oven, hob and extractor hood Bosch (or equivalent), fridge and Hoover washer/dryer (or equivalent). The cabinets are finished in high-gloss laminate, melamine or PET, the countertops are in reconstituted stone and the walls are finished in high-quality acrylic paint with elegant coatings. The bathrooms have toilets and taps from recognised brands such as Duravit (or equivalent) and premium porcelain tiles. The air conditioning system is district-based, with FCU units and provision for home automation. The building has double glazed facades for better thermal and acoustic insulation, charging stations for electric vehicles, an efficient HVAC system with condensate reuse for irrigation and sustainable locally sourced materials, promoting a healthier and greener life. This development has been carefully designed to unite functionality, style and well-being. Typical layouts pair a show kitchen with a separate back-of-house kitchen, a maid's room and a private lift lobby. Shared facilities include an infinity-edge lap pool, a triple-height gym, a cinema room, a children's room, meeting rooms and a spa suite with salon, with concierge, valet and round-the-clock security. Residents can also use the facilities at The Lana hotel, including its spa, through a membership programme, and the beach club at One at Palm Jumeirah.

Â 

The tower sits in the Burj Khalifa District, close to Downtown Dubai, with Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road both nearby. With only 38 homes it is a small building, and it continues Omniyat's work with Foster + Partners and Dorchester Collection that includes ORLA and The Lana.
